title: Theft — Athletic Mascot Property (Cedar Pavilion)
briefing:
INCIDENT SUMMARY (open file)

On 06 Nov, approx. 07:40, Athletics Equipment reported the Nordy the Owl mascot head missing from Cedar Pavilion Equipment Cage E-12. Cage exterior lock found secured at morning inventory; interior count shows head absent and spare jersey displaced. Estimated loss window: 21:00–23:00 on 05 Nov (night before Founders Weekend).

Four persons of interest are flagged on this file. Campus directory and related-person cards are available for cross-reference. Pull public records, compare against sworn statements, and attach relevant items to the working case file before referral.

suspects.statement: I worked the Founders Weekend spirit table at the Mill Student Center until about 22:30, then walked home along North Quad. I did not enter Cedar Pavilion or the equipment cage at any time that night.
